requirement.normalizedRequirement: For ice classes IA and IA Super, the rudder (the rudder stock and the upper part of the rudder) shall be protected from direct contact with intact ice by an ice knife that extends below the LIWL, if practicable (or equivalent means).
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: For ice classes IA and IA Super, the rudder (the rudder stock and the upper part of the rudder) shall be protected from direct contact with intact ice by an ice knife that extends below the LIWL, if practicable (or equivalent means). Special consideration shall be given to the design of the rudder and the ice knife for ships with flap-type rudders.
